questions.title: Extract Error Logs
questions.scenario: The ops team needs every ERROR line from /var/log/app/mixed.log saved to /var/log/app/errors.log for the incident report, without touching the terminal output. Write the command.

questions.title: Bulk Config Replacement
questions.scenario: Several config files under /etc/myapp/ still reference the old hostname old-db.internal. Write a single command to replace every occurrence with new-db.internal across all .conf files in that directory, editing them in place.

questions.title: Top Failing Endpoints
questions.scenario: In access.log, each line has the request path as the 3rd whitespace-separated field. Write a single pipeline that prints the 5 most frequently requested paths with their counts, most frequent first.

questions.title: Validate IP Pattern Matches
questions.scenario: Security wants every line in firewall.log that contains an IPv4-looking address (four dot-separated number groups, e.g. 192.168.1.10). Write a grep command using extended regex to find those lines.

questions.title: Multi-Stage Failure Pipeline
questions.scenario: From deploy.log, pull every line containing FAILED, extract just the service name (the 2nd whitespace-separated field), count how many times each service failed, sort by count descending, and save the full breakdown to failures-summary.txt while still printing it to the screen.
